highRange.scope: Mathematical protected15-to20 hitting-cost expectation using an actually acquired legendary+15 item; unlimited Coin/materials and no income/time/acquisition simulation. Does not unlock the executor or certify rarity/percentiles/completion dates.
highRange.interpretation: Cost-to-income ratios are resource-budget scales, not expected calendar completion times; Jade winnings453/day are not sustainable for every member or guaranteed for one player

limits: Native combat cohorts of1–20; SQL adapter remains limited to20 and is not global sharding
Stats/highest floors are observed daily snapshots from seven acquired V10 simulations, reused as population archetypes; not newly acquired independent accounts or extra wallet grants
Event-only simulation freezes stats and uses exclusive event time; no XP, Coin, offline farming or trade income for the interval, no integrated120day campaign claim
Synthetic owner annotations describe coalition assumptions, not verified identities or an anti-Sybil detector; acquiring and operating multiple developed accounts has a real cost
Timed late-entry trials use hindsight of a deterministic reference death; an adversarial sensitivity test, not a practical success-rate claim
Large-population and30day values are arithmetic ceilings under full qualification and repeated defeat, not measured combat, attendance, server capacity or an inflation forecast
No +16–20 unlock, Ruby, live Jade grant, public account cutover, identity enforcement or boss HP change
